import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        double[] p = new double[n];
        double[] q = new double[n];
        double[] res = new double[1 << n];

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            p[i] = Double.parseDouble(st.nextToken());
            res[1 << i] = p[i];
            q[i] = 0.0;
        }

        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            List<Integer> included = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> excluded = new ArrayList<>();
            double sum_excluded = 0.0;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    included.add(j);
                } else {
                    excluded.add(j);
                    sum_excluded += p[j];
                }
            }

            if (included.size() == m || (included.size() < m && sum_excluded < 1e-5)) {
                for (int x : included) {
                    q[x] += res[mask];
                }
            } else if (included.size() < m) {
                for (int x : excluded) {
                    int new_mask = mask | (1 << x);
                    res[new_mask] += res[mask] * p[x] / sum_excluded;
                }
            }
        }

        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sb.append(String.format("%.15f", q[i])).append(" ");
        }
        System.out.println(sb.toString().trim());
    }
}
